author: HBO Max
description:
On DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast Season 2, Episode 6, hosts Frankey and Coy welcome legendary comic artist, animator, and Milestone Media co-founder Denys Cowan for an unforgettable conversation celebrating one of the most influential creators in DC history. From the creation of Static and the legacy of Milestone to his most recent work on Nightwing, Denys shares incredible behind-the-scenes stories, the inspiration behind his iconic characters, and why bringing new voices into the DC Universe has always been his mission.
Whether you've followed Denys Cowan since The Question, discovered his work through Static Shock, his work on his Prince solo comic, his work with GZA of the Wu-Tang Clan, or are loving his current run on Nightwing, this episode is packed with exclusive stories, comic book history, and the kind of fan-first conversations only DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast can deliver.

On Season 1, Episode 3 of Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, Prop master Sarah Snyder, Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton enter the magic multiverse. Wil shares how “Spoiler: Burt Is Magic” transformed his Big Bang Theory character into a fireball-throwing enforcer, while Sarah offers behind-the-scenes access to the handmade comic books, magical props, and universe-altering device. From Wil’s octopus tattoo spell to a perfectly placed Vulcan salute, this is the SFTSTU conversation superhero and comic book fans cannot miss.
